modals.title: Create Project
modals.description: Create a workspace to group related conversations, instructions, and files.
notes: Create button disabled with empty Name; becomes enabled with Name alone - Description is NOT actually required despite app-guide documenting it as required (drift, live UI wins).

Instructions field is a rich-text editor with a Bold/Italic/Code/Bullet List/Numbered List/Link toolbar, prefilled with an example scaffold template (## describe what is the project / ## Project context / ## Project focus / ## Response style / ## Project rules) similar to the Tasks module's Goal/Context/Steps/Output scaffold.
On submit: toast 'Project created' + 'Slug: <slug> - files will live under projects/<slug>/', then navigates into the new project's chat view.

modals.title: Delete <project name>?
modals.description: This will remove the project and its custom instructions. Conversations inside it stay in your chat history.
notes: Contradicts app-guide section 7 which says deletion 'removes the project + all its conversations' - live UI copy explicitly says conversations persist. Flagged as doc/live drift in plan/projects.md, not filed as a confirmed bug.

modals.title: Project Settings
modals.description: Edit the project details and instructions. Instructions are injected into every conversation that belongs to this project.
notes: Save Changes disabled until a field is actually changed. Same rich-text Instructions editor as Create, but placeholder here is just 'Tailor the agent's behavior for this project…' (no scaffold template on an existing project).

modals.title: Project files — <project name>
modals.description: Drop files here to make them available to every conversation in this project.
notes: Breadcrumb navigation, 'Upload file' / 'Upload folder' / 'Advanced view' buttons.
New projects auto-create memory.md and project.md - both listed with size (e.g. '807 B') and an 'Actions' menu per file: Open, Download, Rename, Delete.

views.name: Project detail (chat scoped to project)
views.openedBy: Click a project card's 'Open project <name>' link
headings: Good morning/afternoon/evening, <user> (project-scoped: '...to help you with in <project name>?')
